_readme: Fictional demo persona. All names and numbers are made up (555-01xx numbers are reserved for fiction). Used for the demo and the evaluation answer key.
name: Ruth
story: Ruth was widowed two years ago and lives alone with her cat, Fifi. She has a procedure with sedation next month and may stay in the hospital for a couple of nights. The clinic told her she needs someone to take her home. Fifi needs feeding while she is away.
